actions.action: Wear protective gloves and eyewear while pruning
Sterilize pruning tools with rubbing alcohol or diluted bleach
Lay a tarp or old sheet around the plant base
Apply Ferber Painting Cactus Fertilizer a few weeks before pruning
Inspect the plant from all angles for dead or damaged leaves and offsets
Cut dead or damaged leaves and offsets close to the base at an angle
Leave the plant in a dry, shaded spot to callus, away from rain or irrigation
Touch the wound to check whether it has calloused
Callus cut offsets for several days before planting
Resume a regular fertilizer feeding schedule after recovery
Monitor for discoloration, softness or wilting for 2-3 weeks
If stress symptoms appear, reduce watering and move the plant to a well-draining location
If rot is severe, remove infected tissue around the area

verdict.reason: This generic agave-pruning ad for fertilizer never says the plant is healthy with a minor thorn wound; keeping wounds dry while they callus is buried among product promotion, and the extra steps are unnecessary but unlikely to seriously harm the plant.
